name: Editorial Reel
tagline: A raw talking-head recording goes in, a vertical reel with magazine-style serif titles, chat pop-ups and word-by-word captions comes out.
description: A reel that keeps moving around you: big serif headlines behind your head in the hook, a prompt box that types, app icons crossed out, a magazine cover, a grid of results, giant words landing, and a comment-keyword ending with a follow button. Pauses and earlier takes are cut out, captions light up word by word, and a lo-fi beat and sound effects are made for you.
bring: Your raw recording of you talking to camera; a plain background helps
Optional: screen recordings, screenshots or clips of what you talk about
Optional: the word people should comment to get your link
get: A 30–60 s vertical reel with serif titles, pop-ups, word-by-word captions, music and sound effects

needs.name: Reel template, starter scene and sound scripts
Hyperframes, which also cuts you out of the background

steps: Cut the pauses and keep the last take of every line
Plan a graphic for every second or so of speech
Cut you out for the headline, big-word and magazine shots
Build it from the template with captions, music and sound effects
Review each version in FrameJam until it's right
